summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a press release about a student recruitment and support services agreement between its subsidiary, Formind Global, and City University Malaysia. This is an ordinary business development with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The agreement covers per-student commissions for recruitment services and is the first operating step under an earlier cooperation framework. There are no deal terms, premium, or board recommendations. The filing is routine and does not trigger any special-situation category.
